completion_promises.criterion_text: WebM with Duration element → correct seconds; Chrome-style streamed WebM (no Duration) → `None`

Handles streamed segments (unknown size marker) by returning None. Comprehensive tests added including: test_webm_with_duration_element (5 seconds), test_webm_streamed_returns_none, test_webm_with_custom_timescale (20 seconds), test_webm_duration_without_timescale (default 1ms), test_webm_8byte_duration (double precision), test_webm_zero_duration. All tests pass. Coverage: 83%.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Ogg/Opus EOS granule → `granule/48000`; header-page granule 0 → `None`; false-sync `OggS` bytes skipped
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented _probe_ogg_duration() that scans backwards for OggS sync pattern, validates page structure, checks EOS flag, and calculates duration as granule/48000. Comprehensive tests added including: test_ogg_opus_eos_granule (3.5s), test_ogg_header_page_granule_zero, test_ogg_false_sync_skipped (2.0s), test_ogg_invalid_version, test_ogg_non_eos_page, test_ogg_negative_granule, test_ogg_too_short, test_ogg_truncated_granule, test_ogg_page_header_truncated. All tests pass. Coverage: 83%.
